_note: CVK-native Dashboard Studio overview. The receiver repo dashboards use cisco.content.* dial-out metric names, so this dashboard is authored against CVK Phase 3 self-metrics.

options.query: | mcatalog values(device) as device WHERE index=$metrics_index$ metric_name="cisco_vk_telemetry_*" | mvexpand device | rename device as label | eval value=label | fields label value | append [| makeresults | eval label="All devices", value="*"] | dedup value | sort label
| mstats latest(_value) as active WHERE index=$metrics_index$ metric_name="cisco_vk_telemetry_active_streams" device="$device$" BY device | stats sum(active) as active

| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=$metrics_index$ metric_name="cisco_vk_telemetry_metric_points_emitted_total" device="$device$" BY metric_name span=5m | eval signal="metric_points" | append [| mstats sum(_value) as value WHERE index=$metrics_index$ metric_name="cisco_vk_telemetry_log_records_emitted_total" device="$device$" BY metric_name span=5m | eval signal="log_records"] | timechart span=5m sum(value) as records by signal

| mstats sum(_value) as reconnects WHERE index=$metrics_index$ metric_name="cisco_vk_telemetry_stream_reconnects_total" device="$device$" BY device subscription | sort - reconnects | rename device as Device subscription as Subscription reconnects as Reconnects

| mstats sum(_value) as transitions WHERE index=$metrics_index$ metric_name="cisco_vk_telemetry_state_transitions_total" device="$device$" BY device subscription path from to | sort - transitions | rename device as Device subscription as Subscription path as Path from as From to as To transitions as Transitions

| mstats sum(_value) as resets WHERE index=$metrics_index$ metric_name="cisco_vk_telemetry_counter_resets_total" device="$device$" BY device subscription metric | sort - resets | rename device as Device subscription as Subscription metric as Metric resets as Resets

| mstats sum(_value) as metric_points WHERE index=$metrics_index$ metric_name="cisco_vk_telemetry_metric_points_emitted_total" device="$device$" BY device subscription | appendcols [| mstats sum(_value) as log_records WHERE index=$metrics_index$ metric_name="cisco_vk_telemetry_log_records_emitted_total" device="$device$" BY device subscription] | fillnull value=0 metric_points log_records | rename device as Device subscription as Subscription metric_points as "Metric Points" log_records as "Log Records" | sort Device Subscription
